pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR0149 live observation transport
pr_body:
## Summary

Implements ADR0149 Engine-native Live Observation and Media Transport on top of the existing Game View FrameCapture and Remote AI Studio boundaries.

- adds bounded authenticated live Game View media sessions using a replaceable PNG encoder abstraction
- caps delivery at 1280x720 and 8 fps while retaining only the latest transient sample
- measures readback, encode, and end-to-end capture overhead per session
- uses a media-session-specific credential in addition to Remote AI Studio authentication
- keeps live samples separate from Agent Host captured-frame audit/completion evidence
- preserves ADR0135 runtime-rendering priority and does not expose renderer/model controls remotely
- adds responsive Remote AI Studio live-view controls without desktop-wide capture or a second input/authoring path

## Validation

Windows affected validation plus Editor Visual Validation are required.
